messages:
Caroline (pm): customer request - fintech client wants "predictable p99" plus occasional bursts. they asked: can reserved pools let tenants burst into unused capacity without breaking SLAs?
Eva (eng): short answer: yes but we need admission controls. propose "soft-quota + capped spillover": baseline tokens per-window + borrowing cap.
Matt (infra): outline tradeoffs: spillover increases aggregate cost and complexity for reconciliation/billing. need per-tenant accounting and a console flag.
Priya (sre): ops concerns: borrowing can create noisy-neighbor spikes. suggest two protections: (1) spillover throttle when overall spill> X% for Y minutes, (2) client backoff guidance to avoid retry storms.
Anya (prod): we ran a small micro-sim earlier. results: soft-quota reduced reserved p99 regressions from 22% to ~6% under 60s bursts, cost delta ~+18% for that workload. attaching summary: https://s3.redwood/sim/softquota-summary.csv
Caroline (pm): good. we need explicit launch gating. my proposed gating for prototype->beta:
- reserved p99 under tenant spike <= 1.25x baseline in 90% of sims
- operational alerts in place (spillover throttled alert + billing spike alert)
- billing model sketched (meter borrowed tokens) and console flag in staging
Eva (eng): technical spec sketch: ```
- admission: per-tenant window (W=300s)
- baseline_tokens = configured quota
- allowed_borrow = ceil(baseline_tokens * spill_pct)
- reconciliation job: run every W to reset counters
- fallback: if cluster_spill > 60% for 5m -> block new borrow requests
```
Matt (infra): implementation notes: reconciliation needs idempotent job; store counters in Redis with TTL=W+60s. billing export: daily aggregate of borrowed_tokens for invoice. console: one boolean "borrow_enabled" per-reservation.
Priya (sre): will add oncall playbook entries: runbook to shard-balance when borrowed tokens > threshold, and dashboard widgets: borrowed_tokens, borrow_rate, spillover_throttle_active.
Caroline (pm): UX ask: show "borrow balance" in customer console with predicted cost impact for current window. product will prototype wording and commit.
Anya (prod): propose pilot criteria + candidate customers: 1) Acme Payments (requested both predictable + burst) 2) BoxCo (high variablity). we should run a customer pilot with opt-in flag and separate billing preview.
Eva (eng): rough dev ETA: proto in staging (admission + counters + throttle) 10 business days. will open PRs and include e2e sim harness.
Matt (infra): infra ETA: support billing export + console flag in 3w. need to coordinate API versioning for reservation config.
Caroline (pm): roadmap placement: Q2 prototype -> Q3 beta -> GA after pilot sign-off. gating review scheduled next Tues.
launch-bot: created follow-up ticket: PLATFORM-4873 "soft-quota spillover prototype" assigned to Eva, Matt, Priya, Caroline. due-date: 2w.
Priya (sre): I'll run stress sims that include client retry models and long-sequence tails. will validate throttle thresholds.
Anya (prod): action items:
- Eva: staging prototype (due: 10bd)
- Matt: billing/export + console flag spec (due: 3w)
- Priya: oncall runbook + stress sims (due: 6bd)
- Caroline: pilot outreach + launch gating doc (due: 5bd)
Caroline (pm): decision for now: greenlight prototype work but gate GA on sim results + pilot feedback. we keep pricing TBD. :eyes:
Eva (eng): noted. will post PR link and testing notes when ready.
Matt (infra): please also add a safe-mode toggle to fully disable borrowing per-cluster for emergencies.
Caroline (pm): added to gating doc. thanks everyone.
